Method of Attack: Tech support scam involving locking browsers, impersonating Apple and Microsoft representatives, and tricking users into paying for unnecessary technical support services
Impacted Systems: Users' personal computers targeted by tech support scams
Attack Vector: Malicious tech support websites that lock browsers and impersonate legitimate companies
Indicators of Compromise: Impersonation of Apple and Microsoft representatives
Payment demands of $200 for one-time fixes or $400/year for recurring support
